tips.text: Pick New Game to start! Use the arrow keys and press Enter, or click.
Pick the place you want to explore first. You can open the others later with map parts.
Welcome to Ansonville! Walk with the arrow keys or WASD. Walk into your open gate to explore.
Hi! Go through your open gate. Walk in tall grass, sand, snow or ash to find wild monsters.
Wild monsters hide in the tall grass, sand, snow and ash. The shop and Reviver are by the exit.
No monster yet? Throw a cage! If it breaks free, try again. After 3 misses it runs away.
Pick Fight to attack. Lower HP means a better chance to catch it. Press F for 2x speed.
Walk into the Reviver to heal your team for free. If you lose a battle, you wake up there.
Press M for the menu: your Team, Backpack, Bag and Monster Book. Press M or Esc to close it.
Pick a monster with Enter, then pick another to swap. The first one on your team fights first.
Pick a Potion or Wake-Up Snack, then pick who gets it. In battle, Bag works the same way.
Your Monster Book shows every monster you have seen and caught. Catch all the wild ones to open Avatar's arena!
Each monster grows into a new form at its own level. Win battles to level up!
Pick something, use left and right for how many, then Enter to buy. A map part opens a new gate!
Locked gates need a map part. Buy one at the shop for 50 Magic Gems. Win battles to earn gems.

topics.question: What buttons do I use?
topics.answer: Arrow keys or WASD to walk and pick. Enter or Space to choose or talk. Esc or Backspace to go back. M opens the menu. You can also click with the mouse.

topics.question: Where are the wild monsters?
topics.answer: They hide in the tall grass, sand, snow and ash in each open place. Walk around there and one will jump out!

topics.question: How do I catch a monster?
topics.answer: In a battle, pick Cage. The tiny cage grows big around the monster. Lower HP means a better chance, so fight a little first. After 3 misses it runs away.

topics.question: I have no monster. What now?
topics.answer: Throw cages! Your first monster has to be caught with a cage. You start with 100 cages.

topics.question: How do battles work?
topics.answer: Pick Fight and a move. Your monster and the wild one take turns. Switch sends in another team monster. Run gets you out of a wild battle. Press F to make it go 2x fast.

topics.question: What are Burned and Frozen?
topics.answer: Burned monsters lose a little HP each turn for a while. Frozen monsters miss their next turn. Those are the only two.

topics.question: What is a Big Monster?
topics.answer: Sometimes a wild monster is BIG. It is stronger, harder to catch, and gets a star in your Monster Book. About 1 in 100!

topics.question: How do I change my team?
topics.answer: Press M and pick Team and Backpack. Pick a monster with Enter, then pick another to swap. The first one on your team fights first. Tab sorts the backpack.

topics.question: How do I heal my monsters?
topics.answer: Walk into the pink Reviver next to a shop. It heals everyone for free! You can also use a Healing Potion from your Bag.

topics.question: How do I use a potion?
topics.answer: Press M, pick Bag, pick the potion, then pick who gets it. In a battle, pick Bag. A Wake-Up Snack wakes up a knocked-out monster.

topics.question: What if all my monsters get knocked out?
topics.answer: You wake up at the last Reviver you used, and your monsters are all better. You don't lose anything!

topics.question: How do monsters grow?
topics.answer: Win battles to get XP and level up. Each monster grows into a new form at its own level. It happens right after the battle!

topics.question: What is the Monster Book?
topics.answer: Press M and pick Monster Book. It shows every monster you have seen and caught. A check means caught. A star means you caught a Big one.

topics.question: How do I get Magic Gems?
topics.answer: Win battles against wild monsters. Each win gives you some gems. Spend them at the shop.

topics.question: What can I buy at the shop?
topics.answer: Cages, Healing Potions, Wake-Up Snacks, Teleport Pins, and map parts. Use left and right to pick how many, then Enter twice to buy.

topics.question: How do I open the other places?
topics.answer: Buy a map part at the shop for 50 Magic Gems. The gate opens right away. There is one for each locked place.

topics.question: How does teleporting work?
topics.answer: Once a monster on your team is level 50, you can teleport to shops and to Teleport Pins you place. You can place 5 pins.

topics.question: Who is Avatar?
topics.answer: Avatar is the boss! Catch every wild monster from every place to open Avatar's arena in the middle of Ansonville.

topics.question: Does the game save?
topics.answer: Yes! It saves by itself when you go to a new place, heal, or finish a battle. Pick Continue on the title screen. For a backup, press M and pick Save to file, then Load save file on the title screen.

topics.question: How do I turn the sound down?
topics.answer: Press M and pick Sound. Each time you press Enter it changes: Off, Low, Medium, High. Off means no music and no sounds. Every place has its own song!

topics.question: Who are you?
topics.answer: I'm Papai! I know everything about this game. Talk to me in Ansonville, or press M and pick Ask Papai anytime.
